messages:
emily: Quick sync — Veridian Labs customer story confirmed for next Wed (3/30) at 10:00am PT. Need legal quote signoff, recording owner, and asset owners. Calendly poll: <https://calendly.example/veridian-interview>

raj: Sweet. Who's owning transcript, pull quotes, and the final social copy?

emily: oliver will run the recording + transcript. sara owns pull quotes and social snippets. kate will do visual assets.

oliver: I can take recording. Prefer Zoom cloud recording + separate local audio. Will book a rehearsal 15 min before. Mic check + room quiet instructions needed.

maria: Legal: please share the exact quote text and any metric calls (e.g., "4x cost reduction"). I can review by EOD Thu but need explicit customer attribution language.

emily: Draft quote below (please edit):
```
"Veridian Labs cut inference costs by 4x and reduced p99 latency by 60% after moving to Redwood Dedicated."
```

kate: Design: we'll need hi-res headshots (400x400), company logo (transparent .png), and one 30s clip for paid social. Can someone confirm who provides those?

sara: I'll gather headshots and create a short brief for the clips. Also creating 3 pull-quote variants: short, medium, long.

raj: Who signs the quote final? Customer success + legal?

emily: Customer success (liam) to approve the numbers and liam + maria to sign the quote.

maria: Also confirm if any operational detail or internal metric will be included. If we publish specific usage metrics we need written consent.

emily: We currently have consent for aggregated improvements; specific numbers need liam sign-off.

oliver: Recording checklist (proposed):
1) 20 min interview + 5 min b-roll
2) Host to use wired headphone mic or lavalier
3) Record local audio track
4) Record separate screen capture if demo is shown
5) Export transcript via otter.ai and save in /marketing/assets/veridian/

emily: @liam — can you confirm the 4x / 60% numbers and sign off on the quote by Fri? :pray:

liam: I'll be on the prep call tomorrow. I'll run the numbers with Ops and confirm by Friday midday.

emily: Timeline:
- Thu: legal review complete
- Fri: customer sign-off
- Mon: final assets to design/PR
- Week after next: publish (social + blog + webinar mention) :tada:

raj: We should also lock a short webinar mention + a follow-up demo invite for leads. I'll draft the messaging once the quote is final.

emily: Great — if legal and liam sign off on schedule we'll be green. I'll post a launch checklist in #launches and schedule rehearsal with oliver. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
